capabilities: Sync vault notes, settings and plugins with a WebDAV server
Record deletions on the server so offline devices never restore deleted files
Merge concurrent edits automatically or section by section in a merge window
Preview risky syncs such as mass deletions and first uploads from a new device
Detect renames and edits made directly in the server folder
extras: README warns users to back up the vault before the first sync and includes full Chinese documentation; no account or telemetry needed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync through a personal WebDAV server, and offline or reinstalled devices can otherwise bring deleted files back.

relations.evidence: Tested with WsgiDAV; any WebDAV server that passes Test connection should work.

summary: Syncs a vault, settings and plugins with a user-owned WebDAV server, recording deletions server-side and merging concurrent edits between devices.
